comment: The CV port also reads 0-10V or volt-per-octave notes when the menu is set to those modes, so its trigger colouring covers the default mode only. What the slot-selection input expects depends on the Slot CV mode: a trigger in the eight sequencing modes and in ARM, a 0 to 10V ramp across the slots in VOLT, and 1V per twelve slots in C4. In C4 mode a second channel on the same cable triggers the load, so there the jack reads two channels of a polyphonic cable; every other mode reads channel one alone.
